breakingChangePolicy: Preserve all released package bytes and evidence. The Product Owner expressly authorized the 12 September 2026 controlled-beta removal of prohibited assessment-prose inputs as correction 1.1.4 under the existing identity, with coordinated backend and catalog rollout. This narrow privacy correction is not a general compatibility exception. Other breaking plugin, identity, OAuth, state or tool-contract changes require a separately approved major-line candidate.

planStatusContractAdoption.scope: Version 1.1.7 adopts the unified backend learning-plan status. The consumed Claude connector-v1 publishes learningPlanToday.text as the only formulation together with non-numeric control fields (periodBasis, evaluable and per-subject evaluable and statusDirection; no overall statusDirection or unavailablePlanCount) and no longer publishes totals or the per-subject counts dueToday, completedToday, openToday, openOverdue and extraCompletedToday. The 1.1.7 skill quotes that text verbatim and performs no plan arithmetic. Extended on 2026-09-17 to the binding concept § 6.5: learningPlanToday.text no longer contains the active-goal announcement; the connector publishes it separately as learningPlanToday.activeGoalAnnouncement, which the skill quotes once when teaching begins.
planStatusContractAdoption.compatibilityImpact: Plugin packages up to and including 1.1.6 instruct Claude to report the removed count fields, and the production connector before this change does not publish learningPlanToday.text. Anthropic applies remote MCP changes on the next connection, so the connector change and the 1.1.7 package must reach production in one coordinated step.
excludes: Deployment, Marketplace publication, Anthropic Console submission, guide activation and inherited candidate acceptance
Connector Directory lifecycle, gates and Team/Enterprise submission access
